sources.label: Clean, ad-free Morphe patches for popular Android apps.
sources.author: GinArena
patch_list: Removes Status Saver, Legal, and Help from the Me page.
Bundles an MX Player custom codec; official v3.1.0_r1 codecs are verified.
Removes ads and online extras like Live TV, Tube, Shorts, and Games for a clean local player.
Removes the bottom navigation bar and moves Me to the top-right corner.
